title: Thiazolidinediones
subtitle: Uses, mechanisms, benefits, side effects, interactions, monitoring, and safety related to thiazolidinediones.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the effectiveness of TZDs in insulin sensitization and glucose lowering, with moderate evidence regarding cardiovascular safety profiles and side effect risks. Emerging data continues to clarify long-term safety and combination therapy roles.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
